stem:
A woman who has taken clozapine for three years phones the clinic with painful mouth ulcers, a sore throat, chills and a temperature of 38.6 °C since yesterday. Her routine four-weekly full blood count, taken five days ago, was normal. She has stopped smoking since becoming unwell. She has no chest pain or breathlessness. The duty doctor arranges same-day medical assessment.

Which blood test is most time-critical because she takes clozapine?

options.label: A
options.text: Troponin and CRP to look for clozapine-induced myocarditis
options.explanation: Myocarditis is mainly a risk in the first one to two months of treatment and usually presents with chest symptoms or tachycardia. After three years, with mouth ulcers and a sore throat, neutropenia is the time-critical concern.

options.label: B
options.text: A clozapine level, as illness and stopping smoking raise it
options.explanation: Infection and stopping smoking can both raise clozapine levels, and a level is worth checking for toxicity. But a high level is not the immediately life-threatening possibility that unrecognised agranulocytosis is.

options.label: C
options.text: Liver function tests for clozapine-induced hepatitis
options.explanation: Hepatic effects are possible but do not explain fever with mouth ulcers, and liver tests do not change the immediate management of possible neutropenic sepsis.

options.label: D
options.text: Blood cultures before any other test is requested
options.explanation: Cultures are needed if she is febrile, but they do not answer the clozapine-specific question. The differential count decides whether this is neutropenic sepsis and whether clozapine must stop.

options.label: E
options.text: A full blood count with differential, though one was normal
options.explanation: Fever, sore throat and mouth ulcers on clozapine need an urgent differential count regardless of a recent normal result, because severe neutropenia can develop between scheduled tests. The result determines whether clozapine is stopped and neutropenic sepsis treated.

context: Signs of infection on clozapine need an urgent differential blood count, even when the routine count a few days earlier was normal.
